name: Grand Battle
notes: Strawhat Simulator's name for Bandai's Extra Regulation: decks may use cards of every block icon, from Block 1 to the newest, so older cards such as OP-01 to OP-04 and ST-01 to ST-09 can be played. Since April 1, 2026 Bandai uses the same banned, banned-pair and restricted lists for Standard and Extra Regulation, so they are copied from standard.json; keep the two in step when the list changes. Bandai lifted the old bans on ST06-015, OP02-024, OP03-098 and OP02-117 for Extra Regulation, so they are not banned here.
